risk_note: H5 dictionary trimmed by reference (apps/h5 build plugin, shared texts loader and key registry; RV1, ruling D10-124 keeps the bundle budget). A build-time collector scans all of apps/h5/src for literal dictionary keys and for dynamic keys covered by registered prefix patterns (ledger_type.*, claim.records.status.*, claim.records.desc.*, claim_reject_reason.*.title, error.*); any non-literal key passed to t() or a wrapper that no pattern covers fails the build. The Vite plugin swaps the dictionary for that subset only in builds and writes trim-texts.json; without the plugin (Vitest, dev server) the full dictionary still loads. Gzip: largest app route 153219 to 142261 bytes (budget 153600), landing first screen 15610 to 4674. Rule tests by Codex in two calls; Claude spec-test review r2 pass; red on the test machine (red/2: 12 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine verify-fast and browser green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34 / 36). Written by hand.
